games.headline: Oops cruises past Slim Shiesties
article: Oops beat Slim Shiesties 120.20 to 107.00 in Week 4, a solid win decided by 13.20 points.

Oops put up 120.20 this week, 6.1 over their projected 114.1 and the 3rd-highest score of the week. Patrick Mahomes carried them with 21.0 points. Malik Nabers (20.2) and Ashton Jeanty (15.6) were the other big contributors.
Nico Collins led Slim Shiesties with 27.3, and Joe Burrow added 25.6.
The letdown for Slim Shiesties was Parker Washington, who managed 1.5 on a 12.8 projection.
Slim Shiesties left 13.20 points on the bench, with Tucker Kraft (13.5) and Mike Evans (10.1) sitting, though even that wouldn't have been enough.
Oops could have scored even more by starting Kyle Monangai (27.5) instead of Rome Odunze (12.4) and Drake Maye (31.4) instead of Patrick Mahomes (21.0).
At quarterback, Joe Burrow (25.6) outdueled Patrick Mahomes (21.0).
Oops improves to 2-2 (8th place). Slim Shiesties drops to 2-2 (5th).
Next week, Oops faces Dena's Team 🏈 (2-2), who are coming off a 28.5-point win over King Henry. Oops will be without Patrick Mahomes (bye), so expect some waiver-wire shopping.
Next week, Slim Shiesties faces * Go Buckeyes (1-3), who are coming off a 20.0-point loss to The Dude Abides.

games.headline: The Dude Abides cruises past * Go Buckeyes

The letdown for * Go Buckeyes was Cam Skattebo, who managed 7.1 on a 15.1 projection.
The letdown for The Dude Abides was Ja'Marr Chase, who managed 4.2 on a 16.6 projection.

The Dude Abides improves to 3-1 (3rd place), winners of 3 straight. * Go Buckeyes drops to 1-3 (12th).

Next week, * Go Buckeyes faces Slim Shiesties (2-2), who are coming off a 13.2-point loss to Oops. * Go Buckeyes will be without Bryce Young (bye), so it's time to check the waiver wire.

games.headline: Stroud and Proud stuns Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup on Monday night
article: Stroud and Proud beat Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup 117.60 to 91.10 in Week 4, a comfortable win decided by 26.50 points.

Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup managed 91.10 this week, 21.5 under their projected 112.5 and the 3rd-lowest score of the week. Chuba Hubbard led the way with 25.4, and Jonathan Taylor added 22.2.
The letdown for Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup was Rashee Rice, who managed 0.0 on a 12.2 projection.
The letdown for Stroud and Proud was Garrett Wilson, who managed 4.2 on a 13.3 projection.
Not much Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup could have done about this one: even their best possible lineup (112.10) wouldn't have caught Stroud and Proud.
Stroud and Proud could have scored even more by starting Emanuel Wilson (25.5) instead of TreVeyon Henderson (4.2) and Ollie Gordon II (17.0) instead of Garrett Wilson (4.2).
Going into Monday night, Stroud and Proud trailed by 6.60 and needed a big night. Tyler Shough (17.5) and Chris Olave (15.6) delivered.
Stroud and Proud improves to 2-2 (4th place). Cleo's Purrrfect Lineup drops to 1-3 (9th).
